description: Add a gated, dry-run-first 'Upload file' -> 'Post comments to tickets' feature after the existing Download button. This is a HIGH-RISK write feature (it posts live comments to SIM tickets via Playwright/Edge). It is strictly additive: no existing pipeline file (run_daily.py, any tools/*.py source-fetching module, existing tests) may change. Independent of FEAT-002 (FEAT-002 touches only existing pipeline files; this feature touches only new files plus server.py/index.html/app.js/style.css additions) — ordered first here only because it is the higher-risk, higher-effort feature.
steps: Create tools/post_comments_runner.py. Parsing: read the uploaded .xlsx with pandas (openpyxl engine, already a project dependency), lower-case and strip() all column headers, require 'url', 'tid', 'remark' columns (case-insensitive match, e.g. accept 'URL', ' Tid ', 'Remark'), strip whitespace from every cell, group rows by url preserving first-seen url order and row order within each url (pandas groupby with sort=False, mirroring the reference script's df.groupby('url')). Treat a row with a blank/missing url, tid, or remark as malformed: exclude it from the posting groups and list it separately in the parse summary (do not raise -- a malformed-rows report is part of the dry-run deliverable).

In post_comments_runner.py add argparse with --input (xlsx path, required), --mode {dry-run,confirmed} (default dry-run), --out-dir (where to write the summary/report/log, required). Implement run_dry_run(input_path, out_dir): parse only (no Playwright import executed, no browser, no network); build a dict with total_rows, unique_url_count, malformed_rows (list of {row_index, reason}), and preview (first 20 grouped comments as {url, tid_count, comment_text} where comment_text is the exact 'TID: {tid} | {remark}' lines joined with newline, matching the reference script's clean_comment format). Write this dict as JSON atomically to out_dir/dry_run_summary.json using the same tmp-file + Path.replace() pattern as tools/run_daily.py's Run.write_progress (write to 'dry_run_summary.json.tmp' then .replace()). Print progress lines to stdout as the subprocess-stdout pattern expects (e.g. a first line 'RUN_DIR=<out_dir>' mirroring run_controller._drain_stdout's RUN_DIR= pointer convention, then 'parsed N rows, M unique urls' etc.), flush=True on every print.

In post_comments_runner.py implement run_confirmed(input_path, out_dir): requires --mode confirmed; never runs implicitly from a dry-run call. Adapt (do not copy verbatim) the reference script's Playwright flow: launch_persistent_context on ooj_paths.EDGE_PROFILE (import from ooj_paths, do not hardcode), same selectors '#sim-communicationActions--createComment' and "button:has-text('Post to Correspondence')", same comment format 'TID: {tid} | {remark}' per row joined by newline per url group, same multi-selector + empty-textbox verification loop. Resume-by-today's-report dedup: before posting, read an existing out_dir/post_comments_report.xlsx if present, and skip any url whose latest row for today's date has Status=='Success' (mirror the reference script's completed_urls_this_run set). DROP the blocking input()-based retry-until-no loop entirely: iterate every pending url exactly once, save the report incrementally after each url (one pd.DataFrame(results).to_excel(out_dir/'post_comments_report.xlsx', index=False) per url, matching the reference script's crash-recovery save), then return/exit. Implement a separate run_retry_failed(input_path, out_dir) entry point that reads the existing report, selects only urls whose latest today-dated row has a Status starting with 'Failed', re-groups just those rows from the original input file, and re-runs the same one-pass posting loop against only that subset (append/update the same report file). Wire --mode retry-failed into the argparse to call this.

Add tools/post_comments_runner.py's module docstring and a `if __name__ == '__main__': main()` CLI entry point that dispatches to run_dry_run/run_confirmed/run_retry_failed based on --mode, writing all output under --out-dir. Verify: `py -3.13 -m pytest tests -q` still shows the pre-existing 69 tests passing (no pipeline file touched yet, so this alone cannot regress anything, but confirms the new module imports cleanly e.g. via a quick `py -3.13 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'tools'); import post_comments_runner"` smoke check from the workspace root).

Create tools/web/post_comments_controller.py with class PostCommentsController mirroring tools/web/run_controller.py's RunController shape: a threading.Lock-guarded instance with upload_and_preview(file_bytes: bytes, filename: str) -> dict that (a) validates the filename ends in .xlsx, (b) saves the bytes to tools/captures/post_comments/uploads/<timestamp>_<original_filename> (mkdir parents=True), (c) refuses with a clear reason dict if a dry-run or confirmed subprocess is already running (self.is_running()) or if run_controller.CONTROLLER.is_running() is True (the shared Edge profile mutual-exclusion guard -- import run_controller and check its module-level CONTROLLER), (d) otherwise spawns `py -3.13 -X utf8 tools/post_comments_runner.py --input <saved_path> --mode dry-run --out-dir tools/captures/post_comments/<timestamp>` as a subprocess exactly like RunController.start_run (stdout=PIPE, stderr=STDOUT, text=True, bufsize=1, CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP on nt), with a daemon stdout-drain thread capturing the OUT_DIR= first line and tailing into a run.log-style file, (e) records self._uploaded_filename and self._last_out_dir so confirm_and_post() can verify the dry-run belongs to the current upload.

In PostCommentsController add confirm_and_post() -> dict: returns a blocked reason dict (never raises) unless ALL of: (a) a dry-run subprocess for the CURRENT uploaded file has completed successfully (check self._last_out_dir/dry_run_summary.json exists and was produced after the current upload's saved path mtime, mirroring RunController._resolve_run_dir's started_at-based staleness guard), (b) no post-comments subprocess (dry-run or confirmed) is currently running, (c) run_controller.CONTROLLER.is_running() is False (the pipeline is not mid-run on the shared Edge profile) -- if any precondition fails, return {'started': False, 'reason': '<specific clear reason>'} ; otherwise spawn `py -3.13 -X utf8 tools/post_comments_runner.py --input <saved_path> --mode confirmed --out-dir <same_out_dir>` the same way as upload_and_preview's subprocess, and return {'started': True}.

In PostCommentsController add retry_failed() -> dict with the same mutual-exclusion guard as confirm_and_post() (pipeline not running, no post-comments subprocess currently running) plus requiring an existing post_comments_report.xlsx with at least one Failed row in the last out_dir; spawns --mode retry-failed against the same out-dir. Add stop() mirroring RunController.stop_run() (taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F on nt, 15s wait). Add get_status(log_tail=40) -> dict returning {running, mode (dry-run/confirmed/retry-failed/None), exit_code, out_dir, log_tail (list of lines), dry_run_summary (parsed dry_run_summary.json or None), report_available (bool), report_rows (list of {tid,url,status,...} parsed from post_comments_report.xlsx if present, capped e.g. 2000 rows mirroring server._read_csv_as_table's limit pattern)}. One process-wide `CONTROLLER = PostCommentsController()` instance at module end, matching run_controller.py's `CONTROLLER = RunController()`.

Add 6 new routes to tools/web/server.py's Handler.do_GET/do_POST, consistent with the existing dispatch-by-exact-path style: POST /post-comments/upload (multipart is unnecessary -- read raw bytes from the request body using Content-Length like _read_body but keep raw, plus an X-Filename header or a JSON-wrapped {filename, content_base64} body -- choose the JSON+base64 approach for consistency with the existing _read_body/_send_json JSON-only pattern, decode and call pcc.CONTROLLER.upload_and_preview); GET /post-comments/status (pcc.CONTROLLER.get_status()); POST /post-comments/confirm (pcc.CONTROLLER.confirm_and_post(), return 409 with the reason when blocked exactly like the existing /run route's 200/409 pattern); POST /post-comments/retry-failed (same 200/409 pattern); POST /post-comments/stop (same shape as /stop); GET /post-comments/report-download (stream tools/captures/post_comments/<out_dir>/post_comments_report.xlsx with the same Content-Disposition attachment pattern as _serve_download, 409 with a clear reason if no report exists yet). Import the new controller module near the top of server.py alongside `import run_controller as rc` (e.g. `import post_comments_controller as pcc`).

Add a new section to tools/web/index.html AFTER the existing '4. Result' card: `

5. Post comments (optional)

...`. Structure: a file picker (``) plus an 'Upload & Preview' button (`#pc-upload-btn`); a preview area (`#pc-preview`) that renders the dry-run summary prominently (total rows, unique URLs, malformed row count/list, first-20 preview) once available; then a visually distinct, initially-disabled 'Post comments to tickets' button (`#pc-post-btn`, suggest `class="danger"` to reuse the existing high-contrast button style) with explicit copy warning this POSTS LIVE, IRREVERSIBLE comments to real SIM tickets (mirror the ADS checkbox's `.hint` warning-copy style used for '...uploads tracking IDs and addresses over a plaintext endpoint...'); a required confirmation checkbox using the existing `.checkbox` class: ``. After posting starts: a live log `
`, a per-URL progress area `#pc-progress`, a Stop button `#pc-stop-btn`, a 'Retry failed' button `#pc-retry-btn` (hidden/disabled unless the status shows failed rows after completion), and a report download link/button `#pc-report-download-btn` pointing at /post-comments/report-download.

Add matching JS to tools/web/app.js: an upload handler on #pc-upload-btn that reads the selected File via FileReader as base64 (or ArrayBuffer -> base64 encode), POSTs to /post-comments/upload as JSON {filename, content_base64}, then starts a dedicated polling loop (e.g. pcPollTimer / pcTick(), following the existing tick()/renderSources() naming and setInterval(…, 2000) pattern) that calls GET /post-comments/status and renders the dry-run summary into #pc-preview once present, enabling #pc-post-btn only when BOTH a successful dry_run_summary exists AND #pc-confirm-check is checked (wire a change listener on the checkbox too, mirroring how #start-btn's enablement already depends on multiple guard conditions in refreshPreflight()). A click handler on #pc-post-btn POSTs /post-comments/confirm and shows the 409 reason via a status paragraph if blocked, exactly like the existing #start-btn handler's `data.reason` fallback pattern. Click handlers for #pc-stop-btn (POST /post-comments/stop) and #pc-retry-btn (POST /post-comments/retry-failed) following the same ok/data.reason pattern as the existing #stop-btn handler. Render per-URL progress and the live log using the same innerHTML-building style as renderSources()/renderLog(), reusing the existing .pbar/.pbar-fill/.badge CSS classes rather than inventing new ones.

Add any new CSS only if the existing classes (.card, .banner.*, .checkbox, .btn-row, .hint, .pbar/.pbar-fill, button.danger, .source/.step-*, .badge.*) are insufficient for the warning-emphasis button/copy described above; prefer reusing them. If a new class is genuinely needed (e.g. a stronger warning banner variant), add it to tools/web/style.css following the existing variable-based color scheme (--err, --warn, var(--line) etc.) and naming convention (lower-kebab-case class names scoped under the relevant component).

Ensure tools/captures/post_comments/ (uploads/ and per-run out-dirs) is covered by tools/sanitize_captures.py's existing generic allowlist. Read tools/sanitize_captures.py's _is_within/CAPTURES containment check again at implementation time to CONFIRM it already walks every subdirectory of tools/captures/ by resolved-path containment with no hardcoded subdirectory allowlist (confirmed true during planning: sanitize() does `for entry in CAPTURES.rglob('*')` with no name-based directory filter other than '_browser_downloads' and the partial-suffix check) -- if that confirmation holds, make NO changes to sanitize_captures.py (do not weaken or need to touch its containment logic). Only if the implementer's re-read finds it is NOT fully generic should sanitize_captures.py be minimally extended to include tools/captures/post_comments/ in whatever allowlist exists, never weakening the existing containment check.

Add offline tests in a new tests/test_post_comments.py (new file; do not touch any existing test file) using fakes/tmp_path -- NO real Playwright/Edge/network. Cover: (a) parsing/validation -- a small in-memory or tmp_path-written xlsx (via openpyxl, built in the test) with mixed-case headers and whitespace, one malformed row (blank tid), asserting run_dry_run's returned/written summary has the right total_rows/unique_url_count/malformed_rows/preview shape and format of the preview comment text; (b) the mutual-exclusion guard -- patch/stub run_controller.CONTROLLER.is_running to return True and assert PostCommentsController.confirm_and_post() (and retry_failed()) returns a blocked dict with a clear reason and never spawns a subprocess (patch subprocess.Popen to raise AssertionError if called, mirroring tests/test_scc_retry.py's _FakePage pattern of asserting a forbidden call is never made); (c) the dry-run-required-before-confirm guard -- a fresh PostCommentsController with no prior dry-run summary file must have confirm_and_post() return blocked without spawning anything; and a case where a dry_run_summary.json exists but is OLDER than the current uploaded file's mtime (simulating a stale dry-run for a different file) must also block. Verify: `py -3.13 -m pytest tests -q` passes with 69 + (new test count) tests, 0 failed.
acceptance_criteria: `py -3.13 -m pytest tests -q` reports at least 69 passed plus the new tests in tests/test_post_comments.py, 0 failed, and no existing test file was modified.

Real posting (run_confirmed / POST /post-comments/confirm) is unreachable without: a prior successful dry-run of the exact current uploaded file, the UI confirmation checkbox checked (client-side) AND the controller's own precondition checks (server-side) passing, and run_controller.CONTROLLER.is_running() being False -- verified by the offline guard tests, not just by UI wiring.

No file under tools/*.py other than the new tools/post_comments_runner.py and tools/web/post_comments_controller.py is modified for this feature (run_daily.py and all existing source-fetching modules are untouched), confirmed by review of the final diff.

tools/web/server.py, index.html, app.js, style.css contain only additive changes for this feature (new routes, new section, new JS block, optionally new CSS classes) with no modification to existing routes/sections/handlers.
The uploaded file path is accepted at runtime via the upload route (never hardcoded in post_comments_runner.py or post_comments_controller.py).
verification: py -3.13 -m pytest tests -q   (from workspace root; expect 69 + new >= 69 passed, 0 failed)
py -3.13 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'tools'); import post_comments_runner, sys; print('ok')"   (from workspace root; smoke-check the new module imports without executing Playwright)

Manual/visual check (not required to be automated): restart the local server and confirm the new '5. Post comments (optional)' section renders after '4. Result' and the Post button stays disabled until a dry-run preview succeeds and the checkbox is ticked.
findings: COMPLETED. New files: tools/post_comments_runner.py (parse_workbook + run_dry_run/run_confirmed/run_retry_failed + argparse main dispatching on --mode; dry-run NEVER imports Playwright — playwright + ooj_paths.EDGE_PROFILE are imported lazily inside _launch_and_post only; atomic dry_run_summary.json via <name>.tmp + Path.replace; comment format 'TID: {tid} | {remark}' joined by newline per url group; one-pass posting with incremental per-url post_comments_report.xlsx save and same-day Status==Success resume dedup; retry-failed re-runs only latest-today Failed urls) and tools/web/post_comments_controller.py (PostCommentsController mirroring RunController: threading.Lock, single subprocess, daemon stdout drain capturing RUN_DIR= into run.log, upload_and_preview/confirm_and_post/retry_failed/stop/get_status, module-level CONTROLLER). Additive-only edits: tools/web/server.py (added `import post_comments_controller as pcc` + `import base64,binascii`; 6 routes: POST /post-comments/upload (JSON {filename, content_base64}), GET /post-comments/status, POST /post-comments/confirm (200/409), POST /post-comments/retry-failed (200/409), POST /post-comments/stop (200/409), GET /post-comments/report-download; new handlers _post_comments_upload + _serve_report_download); tools/web/index.html (new '5. Post comments (optional)' section after '4. Result' with #pc-file-input, #pc-upload-btn, #pc-preview, danger zone with #pc-confirm-check + #pc-post-btn.danger + #pc-stop-btn + #pc-retry-btn, #pc-progress, #pc-log, #pc-report-download-btn); tools/web/app.js (pcUpload/fileToBase64/pcTick/pcRenderPreview/pcRefreshGate/pcRenderProgress/pcRenderLog + button handlers + 2s pcPollTimer); tools/web/style.css (added .pc-preview*, .pc-danger-zone, .hint.pc-warn, pre#pc-log, etc. reusing existing vars/.pbar/.badge/.banner/.checkbox/button.danger). SAFETY GATE enforced server-side in controller (not just UI): confirm_and_post/retry_failed return a blocked {started:False, reason} and never spawn unless (a) a dry_run_summary.json exists for the current upload and is newer than the upload mtime (_dry_run_ready staleness guard, 2s tolerance), (b) no post-comments subprocess running, (c) run_controller.CONTROLLER.is_running() is False. sanitize_captures.py was re-read and confirmed fully generic (CAPTURES.rglob('*') + _is_within containment, only _browser_downloads/partial-suffix special-casing) — NO change made, tools/captures/post_comments/ is covered automatically. Tests: tests/test_post_comments.py added (8 tests: dry-run parse/format + malformed-row report, dry-run-never-imports-playwright, missing-column raises, pipeline-running blocks confirm+retry, no-prior-dry-run blocks, stale-summary blocks, all-preconditions-pass spawns exactly once, non-xlsx upload rejected). Full suite: 69 baseline -> 77 passed, 0 failed (delta +8). Smoke import OK. No git in workspace (none attempted). Dated entry added to Docs/changes.md (2026-10-05). DEVIATIONS: none material. Minor: upload route uses JSON+base64 (not multipart) per the spec's chosen approach; base64/binascii imports added to server.py; filename is sanitized via os.path.basename before saving under tools/captures/post_comments/uploads/<timestamp>_<name>.
